text_description: A runway look shown from the upper torso down, centered on a voluminous midi skirt with a full, flared silhouette. The skirt is cut in alternating narrow red and white vertical stripes that bend and radiate with the movement of the fabric, creating a tent-like A-line shape from the waist to an uneven, softly swinging hem. Beneath the striped outer layer, dense golden straw- or raffia-like fringe protrudes in thick tiers, visible around the lower edge and adding bulky texture and movement below the skirt. The upper garment is only partially visible: a colorful, textured sleeveless or short-sleeved top sits above the skirt, with painterly bands of cream, yellow, green, red, and black and the word “BIARRITZ” visible near the lower front edge. The model’s arms are bare and stacked with multiple metallic bracelets at both wrists. Footwear consists of low, pointed or almond-toe shoes in a two-tone black and light beige/cream combination, with a dark toe area and pale front edging visible as the model walks. The overall styling mixes graphic stripe tailoring with craft-like fringe texture and a vivid vacation-souvenir color palette.
